_comment: Arc Sentinel lens experiments-integrity (PLAN D44, card E10.6): which repo paths carry
control behaviour for each experiment area (arc.experiments.models.Area). A commit to main
that touches one of an area's paths while an experiment in that area is running changes
control mid-run unless it ships behind a flag defaulting to control. Globs use fnmatch
('*' also crosses '/'). 'other' (A/A calibrations and cross-cutting tests) is every path
below. Installed next to sentinel_experiments.py by hermes/sentinel/install.sh; edit here
(repo copy) and re-run install.sh, never in the profile.
